summary: Completed backend regression and frontend smoke/e2e testing for dashboard, SKU search, product creation surface, stock validation, reports navigation, and responsive sidebar.

integration_issues.issue: The Filter produk input has an onChange handler that does nothing, so typing into this visible control never filters results. Global SKU search works.

action_items: Wire products-search-input to local filtering or remove the non-functional duplicate filter control.
critical_code_review_comments: Products local filter is a dead interactive control because its onChange handler is empty; this conflicts with the visible filter affordance and search requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created one UI/API test product transaction set and test receipt/sale rows using TEST/UI-TEST prefixes; these remain in the Excel workbook.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard, global SKU search, duplicate SKU API validation, receipt/sale stock behavior, movement/export endpoints, over-stock UI validation, reports navigation, and mobile sidebar passed. Retest the Products local filter after wiring it.
rca of the issue: Products renders products-search-input with value={query} and onChange={() => {}}. Because query is controlled by App and the handler does not update it, direct typing cannot change the displayed dataset; only the global header search updates query.
